legal.summary: RBI barred Arohan from lending Oct 2024; restrictions lifted Jan 2025

legal.description: RBI issued cease and desist from sanctioning and disbursing loans to Arohan Financial Services, citing excessive interest spread over cost of funds not adhering to regulations. Part of broader action on 4 NBFCs (Asirvad, Arohan, DMI Finance, Navi Finserv).
RBI lifted supervisory restrictions on Arohan effective Jan 3, 2025. Company initiated remedial action and submitted compliances including ensuring fairness in loan pricing.
Arohan downgraded to default rating by ICRA, then subsequently upgraded.
Arohan awarded top-notch MFI 1 grade by CARE Edge Advisory; Code of Conduct Assessment received C1 grading.

products.name: Saral
products.description: Principal core loan product for women in low-income areas in trade/services. JLG model, groups of 2-5 women, centres up to 30 members. Loan amounts INR 25,000-147,500, tenure 24-30 months. Interest 19.99%-25%.

products.name: Micro Enterprise Loan (MEL)
products.description: Collateral-free individual loan products for working capital of small businesses at established premises. Predominantly male customers. Loan amounts INR 50,000-5,00,000, interest 24.24%-26%.

products.name: ArohanPrivilege Digital
products.description: Advanced technology-based digital loan sourcing facility. e-KYC, e-signing, cashless disbursal and repayment. Loan amounts INR 20,000-1,00,000, interest 24.24%, tenure 5-30 months.

products.name: Cross-Sell Products (Insurance)
products.description: Life and health insurance products distributed via ApnaBazaar technology platform. Partners include Bajaj Life, HDFC Life, Kotak Mahindra Life. Products include group life insurance, credit protection, Hospicash.

products.name: Other Products (Financial Safety Net)
products.description: Term life insurance, Hospicash (hospital cash benefit Rs 1,000/day non-ICU, Rs 2,000/day ICU), personal accident cover up to Rs 2,00,000, critical illness Rs 60,000.
